notes.title: Miko no Kanata: Curious Tales from Oguni Shrine -Cycles- Released on Steam!
notes.content:
Did you enjoy Real Life Plus Ver. Kaname Komatsuzaki? Are you looking for more works from the developer? Check out the recently released title Miko no Kanata: Curious Tales from Oguni Shrine -Cycles- on Steam! We've also created a bundle where you can buy both games from the developer with a little extra discount. Check it out!
